$comment: Hand-approved river names (HydroRIVERS has none). Keyed by mouth reach (HYRIV_ID). Names use IGN spelling (FUENTE: Instituto Geográfico Nacional de la República Argentina), chosen by the owner on 2026-10-01 over the earlier OpenStreetMap spelling; pipeline:ign-match's stem vote (data/work/ign-match/report.json) confirms the IGN name along each river's main stem. `slug` is the river's id (URLs, Mongo _id) and never changes once published, even if the name does; `aliases` are former names that search still finds. shortName/type are the name split at its first word. Approved by the project owner on 2026-09-30, IGN names on 2026-10-01.

rivers.name: Río Negro
rivers.evidence: OpenStreetMap waterway name at 5/5 sample points along the mouth segment (pipeline:osm-names, candidate #1, 2026-09-30); IGN name 'Río Negro' on 100% of the 711 km stem that has an IGN candidate (pipeline:ign-match, 2026-10-01)
